tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Corrigendum / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the KPP portal only.

Tenderers are required to read the Bid Documents carefully before submission of their bid. Any discrepancies observed in the documents uploaded by the tenderer the tender shall liable to rejected. The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason or what so ever. Conditional tenders will not be accepted.

Work done certificate should be issued by competent authority not below the rank of Executive Engineer and Submitted Work done certificate should include E-PROCUREMENT INDENT NUMBER. The Tenderer shall scan Original Workdone certificates / Turnover Statements and any other documents specified by the employer and attach the scanned file to the Bid. The Original Documents shall be produced for physical verification within one week from the date of Technical bid opening or when called for during evaluation of tender.
As per Government Order NO: FD 884 EXP-12/2019 Dated: 07-05-2020 action will be taken if the documents submitted by the tenderer found to be misleading /forged or fake.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Tenderer should submit valid company registration certificate/ Trade License
The tenderer should have provided similar services related to IEC, Event management, training etc.of value 12 lakh or higher in any one of the last 3 financial years

The tenderer/manufacturer should not have been debarred/blacklisted by any State Government, Central Government, Govt Undertakings/ Enterprises/ Organizations/ SPVs for non-satisfactory performance, corrupt & Fraudulent or any other unethical business practices, not meeting critical conditions/security clearance etc., during the past. Declaration of same to be submitted by tenderer

To qualify for award of this contract each tender in its name should have in last three years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26 achieved in at least one financial year a minimum financial turnover of Rs. 12.00 Lakhs. Audited Balance Sheet / Turnover certificate of the company duly audited/attested by chartered accountants for the said Financial Year
